user.title: RoomHeat
user.description: Global settings and the central heating schedule. Rooms are added afterwards with “Add room”.

data_description.outdoor_temperature_sensor: Optional. Used by the thermal model.
data_description.central_thermostat: The thermostat that calls for central heating (the living room one). Optional.
data_description.ac_unit: The ducted heat-pump unit, used when central heating is not available. Optional.
data_description.central_hours_end: Central heating is only available between these times, every day of the season.
data_description.ac_power_sensor: Optional. Measured electrical power of the AC; used to know when it really runs and what it costs.
data_description.central_heat_price: Price per kWh of heat consumed. Leave out any fixed fee: it does not change with usage.
data_description.electricity_price: Final price per kWh including taxes. Used to cost the AC.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. Replaces the outdoor sensor when it is unavailable, and records cloud cover and wind, which explain solar gain and draughts.

user.title: Add room
user.description: Pick the Home Assistant area this room corresponds to.

data_description.temperature_sensors: Sensors placed in the room; the room temperature is their average. Pre-filled from this area when one is found.
data_description.device_temperature_sensors: Optional. Sensors on a heating device, e.g. a radiator valve. They are not averaged into the room temperature.
data_description.valves: Optional. The room's radiator valves (climate entities). Open while their action is heating; the model uses this to know when the radiators really heat this room. Leave empty for radiators without a controllable valve.
data_description.adjacent_rooms: Other configured rooms that share a wall, floor or open door with this one.

error.already_configured: This area is already a room.
